faqHotes.intro: Everything you need to know to list your cabin on Kabanalouer
faqHotes.s1q1: How do I create my listing?
faqHotes.s1a1: Create a free owner account, fill in your cabin information (photos, description, amenities, calendar), then activate your listing via the «Publish my listing» section.
faqHotes.s1q2: How long does it take to create a listing?
faqHotes.s1a2: Between 15 and 30 minutes for a complete listing. Our AI can generate your title and description automatically.
faqHotes.s1q3: Do I need a CITQ number?
faqHotes.s1a3: Yes, a valid 6-digit CITQ number is required to publish your listing on Kabanalouer, in accordance with Quebec regulations.
faqHotes.s2q1: How many photos can I add?
faqHotes.s2a1: Up to 80 photos per listing. A minimum of 5 photos is required to publish. Photos are automatically compressed to WebP for optimal quality.
faqHotes.s2a2: Accepted formats: JPG, PNG, WebP. Maximum size: 2 MB per photo after automatic compression. Recommended resolution: minimum 1920 px.
faqHotes.s3q1: How do I manage my availability?
faqHotes.s3a1: In your dashboard, go to the Calendar section of your listing. You can block dates manually or sync automatically via iCal (Airbnb, Booking.com, etc.).
faqHotes.s3a2: Yes, automatic sync runs every hour. You can also force a manual sync at any time.
faqHotes.s4a1: Via Kabanalouer's built-in messaging. You receive an email notification for each new message.
faqHotes.s4a2: Travelers contact you through our messaging system. Their contact details (email, phone) are included in their contact request.
faqHotes.s5q1: What happens if I don't renew?
faqHotes.s5a1: Your listing is automatically unpublished at expiry. Your data is kept for 90 days.
faqHotes.s5a2: Yes, each cabin requires its own subscription at 299 $/year.
faqHotes.s5q3: Does the free offer apply to all my cabins?
faqHotes.s5a3: The free offer applies to the first 50 subscriptions activated on the platform, across all owners.
faqHotes.ctaSubtitle: Our team is available to help you.

commentCaMarche.intro: Find and book your ideal Quebec cabin in 3 simple steps.
commentCaMarche.step1Desc: Use our search engine to find the perfect cabin. Filter by region, dates, number of travelers, and amenities. Browse photos, availability, and previous traveler reviews.
commentCaMarche.step2Desc: Send a message directly to the owner through our built-in messaging. Ask your questions, discuss stay details, and get confirmation. No middleman — direct contact with the owner.
commentCaMarche.step3Desc: Once your stay is confirmed with the owner, all that's left is to pack your bags and enjoy your getaway in the heart of Quebec!
commentCaMarche.why1Desc: Unlike major platforms, Kabanalouer charges no service fees to travelers. The listed price is the price you pay.
commentCaMarche.why2Desc: No middleman. You communicate directly with the owner to customize your stay.
commentCaMarche.why3Desc: All our owners are verified. Authentic cabins across Quebec, for every budget and every season.
commentCaMarche.faq1A: No. Kabanalouer is a connection platform. Payment is made directly between you and the owner, according to the terms you agree on.
commentCaMarche.faq2Q: How do I contact an owner?
commentCaMarche.faq2A: Click «Contact the owner» on the cabin listing. You need to create a free account to send a message.
commentCaMarche.faq3Q: Do I need to pay to create an account?
commentCaMarche.faq3A: No, creating a traveler account is completely free.
commentCaMarche.faq4Q: How do I know if a cabin is available?
commentCaMarche.faq4A: Each listing shows an availability calendar updated by the owner. You can also filter by dates in the search.
commentCaMarche.faq5Q: What if the owner doesn't respond?
commentCaMarche.faq5A: We recommend waiting 24–48 hours. If you haven't heard back, feel free to contact another similar cabin.
commentCaMarche.ctaSubtitle: Hundreds of Quebec cabins are waiting for you.

aPropos.intro: Connecting Quebec travelers with the most beautiful cabins in the province. No middleman, no hidden fees.
aPropos.story1: Kabanalouer was born from a simple observation — existing platforms charge high service fees, complicate communication between owners and travelers, and aren't suited to the reality of Quebec cabins.
aPropos.story2: We created Kabanalouer to change that: a simple, transparent platform 100% dedicated to Quebec. Here, travelers contact owners directly, without going through a middleman who takes a commission on every transaction.
aPropos.story3: Our model is simple: owners pay a fixed annual subscription to list their cabin. Travelers access all listings for free. No commission, no service fees, no surprises.
aPropos.val1Desc: We showcase unique Quebec cabins, from the Laurentians to the Gaspésie. Each listing tells a story, a place, an experience.
aPropos.val2Desc: We believe the best experience comes from a direct relationship between owners and travelers. No middleman stands between you.
aPropos.val3Desc: No hidden commissions, no surprise fees. A simple, honest model for everyone — the listed price is the price you pay.
aPropos.ctaSubtitle: Whether you're looking for a cabin for your next getaway or want to list your property, Kabanalouer is made for you.
